strings.menu.practiceDisclaimer: Practice results do not count toward your server profile.
strings.menu.profileHelp: Profiles are saved on the server; New guest creates a separate player.
strings.hud.recovery.running: Your rider is running back to the bike. The race continues.
strings.hud.recovery.calm: Stay calm. Find your rhythm again.
strings.results.wreckDetail: The race is over. Try again with a better line.
strings.settings.title: SETTINGS.
strings.settings.qualityHelp: Medium offers a balanced experience. Lower the quality if frame pacing is uneven.
strings.settings.reducedMotionHelp: Reduce camera shake and transitions; combat cues remain visible.
strings.settings.navigationHelp: TAB / ARROW KEYS or D-PAD to navigate · ENTER / A to confirm
strings.settings.contextRace: The race continues while settings are open. Bike input is suspended.
strings.settings.contextIdle: Adjust the settings to find your racing rhythm.
strings.display.title: WINDOWS DISPLAY
strings.display.help: Resolutions come from the current monitor. Graphics quality is selected separately.
strings.display.requested: Requested {resolution} · {mode}. Windows applies the change at the end of the frame.
strings.practice.title: CHOOSE YOUR RIDE.
strings.practice.help: Practice freely with every available bike and rider. Results do not count toward your server profile.
strings.content.heading: PREPARING YOUR RIDE.
strings.career.account.expiredCredentialHint: The saved profile key has expired or been revoked. Registered accounts can still log in or recover access above.
strings.career.account.forgetCredentialConfirm: Forget the old key on this computer? You will no longer be able to access the old anonymous profile with this key. If you upgraded your account, log in or recover the account to keep your progress; server backups still require the host's recovery process. After forgetting the key, CONNECT PROFILE will create a new profile.
strings.career.account.heading: KEEP YOUR CAREER.
strings.career.account.logoutAllConfirm: Log out every session for this account? You will need to log in again on each computer.
strings.career.account.logoutConfirm: Revoke the profile key on this computer and end the current session?
strings.career.account.newRecoveryNotice: SAVE YOUR NEW RECOVERY CODE · Shown only this time
strings.career.account.pasteHint: You can paste passwords and codes. Logging in ends the open session before switching profiles.
strings.career.account.recoveryInputLabel: RECOVERY CODE (ONLY IF YOU FORGOT YOUR PASSWORD)
strings.career.account.securityHint: Accounts belong to this server. Logging in, registering and changing passwords require HTTPS. A single-use recovery code replaces email recovery; save it somewhere private.
strings.career.backup.heading: OFFLINE LAN BACKUP
strings.career.backup.importConfirm: Import this save? The server will check its source and validity before replacing your offline progress.
strings.career.backup.onlineRestriction: Text backups are only for offline LAN profiles; online data is managed on the server.
strings.career.backup.privacyHint: This save can only be imported back into this offline profile and must pass server checks. Saves contain personal data; only paste or store them somewhere you trust.
strings.career.bike.previewTooltip: View the design of {bike} and return to your profile.
strings.career.bike.stats:
LIMIT {speed} km/h  ·  ACCELERATION ×{acceleration}
BRAKING {braking} m/s²  ·  CORNERING GRIP ×{cornering}
strings.career.campaign.complete: CAREER COMPLETE · You can race your current level again or practice freely.
strings.career.campaign.heading: 5 LEVELS. 25 RACES.
strings.career.campaign.leaveRoom: Leave the current room before creating a career race.
strings.career.campaign.progressionHint: Finish in the top 3 on all 5 routes to advance a level. Choose a race from your current level; practice results do not count toward your server profile.
strings.career.characters.connectProfile: Connect a saved profile to select your career rider. Practice lets you try every unlocked rider.
strings.career.characters.heading: CHOOSE THE FACE OF YOUR CAREER.
strings.career.characters.leaveRoom: Leave the current room before changing your profile's rider.
strings.career.characters.portraitPending: The portrait will appear when the content loads.
strings.career.characters.selectionHint: 8 riders, each with a different style. Your choice changes appearance; strength and rewards stay the same.
strings.career.error.alreadyOwned: This bike is already in your garage. Refresh to select it.
strings.career.error.authRequired: Connect a saved profile or log in to an account first.
strings.career.error.foreignSave: This save belongs to another profile or server and cannot be imported into this profile.
strings.career.error.httpsRequired: Change the server address to wss:// to log in over a TLS connection.
strings.career.error.insufficientCredits: You do not have enough funds for this transaction. Complete more races.
strings.career.error.invalidCredentials: The username, password or recovery code is incorrect.
strings.career.error.invalidPassword: Passwords must contain 12–128 characters. Use a long password unique to this account.
strings.career.error.invalidSave: This save is invalid or has been changed. Use an unmodified export from the server.
strings.career.error.invalidUsername: Usernames must contain 3–24 characters: a–z, 0–9, underscores or hyphens.
strings.career.error.networkUnavailable: No response received. Check your connection; Retry keeps the same transaction ID.
strings.career.error.notBankrupt: Your profile still has a working bike or enough funds for repairs. Refresh your garage to continue your career.
strings.career.error.profileBusy: Leave the race room before making this transaction.
strings.career.error.rateLimited: Too many actions in a short time. Wait a moment, then try again.
strings.career.error.repairRequired: Your selected bike is wrecked. Repair it before trading or racing.
strings.career.error.staleSave: This save is outdated. Export the latest version to preserve your current transactions.
strings.career.error.storageUnavailable: The server could not save your data. Try again later; no balance change has been confirmed.
strings.career.error.unknown: The action could not be completed ({code}). Refresh your profile and check the data you entered.
strings.career.error.usernameUnavailable: That username is already taken. Choose another.
strings.career.garage.bankruptNotice: CAREER HALTED · Your bikes are wrecked and you cannot afford repairs.
strings.career.garage.empty: There are no bikes in your garage yet.
strings.career.garage.leaveRoom: Leave the room before changing or repairing bikes.
strings.career.garage.previewHint:
Select a bike to preview it. Your active bike changes
when the server confirms.
strings.career.garage.restartConfirm: Start over? Your current bikes and campaign progress will be lost. Spark 450 returns fully repaired, with a $0 balance. Your account and transaction history are kept.
strings.career.garage.thumbnailPending: The bike image is waiting for a verified 3D render.
strings.career.ledger.authorityHint: Balances and rewards change only after the server records them successfully.
strings.career.ledger.heading: TRANSACTION HISTORY
strings.career.notice.default: Your progress is confirmed by the server. Refresh to update it.
strings.career.notice.equip: Bike selected for the next race.
strings.career.notice.export: Your save is ready. Select all of its contents to copy it.
strings.career.notice.forget: The old key was forgotten on this computer. Select CONNECT PROFILE to create a new profile, or log in to an account.
strings.career.notice.recover: Password changed. Save your new recovery code.
strings.career.notice.register: Profile upgraded. Save your recovery code.
strings.career.notice.restart: Career restarted: Spark 450 is fully repaired, with a $0 balance.
strings.career.notice.rotateRecovery: New recovery code created. The old code no longer works; save the new one.
strings.career.profile.guestTransactions: Guest sessions cannot make profile transactions.
strings.career.profile.storageHint: Profiles are stored on the selected server. New guests and offline practice do not add progress to this garage.
strings.career.shop.compareHint: Select a model to compare with your current bike. Prices, ownership and condition are confirmed by the server.
strings.career.shop.heading: FIND YOUR SETUP.
strings.career.shop.leaveRoom: Leave the room before changing, buying or repairing bikes.
strings.career.shop.tradeConfirm: Sell your current bike for ${tradeValue} and buy {bike} for ${cost}?
strings.career.status.awaitingConfirmation: Waiting for server confirmation. Please wait.
strings.career.summary.connectToSave: Connect a profile to save your career.
strings.career.summary.empty: Connect a profile to start your career.
strings.career.summary.offline: {player}   /   ${credits}   /   LEVEL {level}   /   LAN PROFILE · SEPARATE FROM ONLINE
strings.client.config.invalid: Server configuration is invalid. Using LAN mode on this computer; fix RacingBois.runtime.json to play online.
strings.client.storage.read: The browser cannot read the saved profile. Allow site storage or choose New guest.
strings.client.storage.write: Cannot save data on this device. This session can continue, but restarting may lose your profile or reserved place.
strings.content.route.unavailable: This route does not have a ready content pack yet.
strings.content.catalog.failed: Could not load the content catalog. Check your connection and try again.
strings.content.download.interrupted: Content download was interrupted. Please try again.
strings.content.bundle.invalid: The content pack is damaged or incompatible with this version.
strings.content.version.unavailable: Content is not ready or belongs to another game version. Restart or try again.
strings.client.endpoint.credentials: Enter a valid ws:// or wss:// address without login credentials.
strings.client.endpoint.invalid: Enter a valid ws:// or wss:// address.
strings.client.player.name.invalid: Player names must contain 1–24 characters and no formatting codes.
strings.client.room.settings.invalid: The room name or opponent count is invalid.
strings.client.course.unavailable: This route is locked or the level is invalid.
strings.client.timeline.resync: The timeline needs to be synchronized again.
strings.client.disconnect.unconfirmed: Connection closed; the server has not confirmed leaving the session.
strings.client.session.suspended_before_welcome: The session was suspended before connection details arrived.
strings.client.session.other_tab: This session is open in another tab. Choose New guest to play as another player.
strings.client.leave.unconfirmed: The server has not confirmed leaving the session.
strings.client.session.restore.failed: Could not restore the session. Please reconnect.
strings.client.room.required: You have not joined a room.
strings.client.response.too_large: The server response exceeds the limit.
strings.client.response.invalid: Server data is invalid. The session stopped to resynchronize safely.
strings.client.state.missing: A state message is missing. Recovering…
strings.multiplayer.invite.received: Invitation {code} received. Connect and choose JOIN ROOM when you are ready.
strings.multiplayer.level.mismatch: Your profile is at level {current}. This room is still at level {room}; leave it and create a race at your current level.
strings.multiplayer.validation.code: Room codes have 6 characters. Check the code you received.
strings.multiplayer.validation.create: Choose an unlocked route and name your room before continuing.
strings.multiplayer.validation.route: This route is not ready yet.
strings.multiplayer.level.guest: Guest sessions can only race at level 1. Leave this room, then create or join a level 1 room.
strings.multiplayer.content.incomplete: The race content has not finished loading.
strings.multiplayer.message.saving: The server is confirming your saved points and rewards. Please stay connected.
strings.multiplayer.message.reconnecting: Your place is held while you reconnect. Return to the menu to end this session.
strings.multiplayer.message.results: The room's official results. Return to the lobby together to start another race.
strings.multiplayer.message.browser: Create your own race or enter a code to ride with friends.
strings.multiplayer.message.room: The room code is below. Invite friends, get ready and wait for the host to start.
strings.multiplayer.hint.countdown: All riders are ready. Hold steady; the race is about to begin.
strings.multiplayer.hint.not-ready: You are not ready. Press READY to join the start.
strings.multiplayer.hint.waiting: Ready. Waiting for the other riders.
strings.multiplayer.hint.host: Everyone is ready. You can start the race.
strings.multiplayer.hint.members: Everyone is ready. Waiting for the host to start.
strings.multiplayer.result.receiving: Receiving official results from the server…
strings.multiplayer.result.saved: RESULTS SAVED · Guest rewards apply only to this session.
strings.multiplayer.result.pending: AWAITING SAVE CONFIRMATION · Profile rewards are not confirmed yet.
strings.multiplayer.error.room-full: This room is full. Choose another room or create a new one.
strings.multiplayer.error.room-not-found: Room not found. Check the code or refresh the list.
strings.multiplayer.error.room-started: The race has started. You can join once the room returns to the lobby.
strings.multiplayer.error.host-only: Only the host can do this.
strings.multiplayer.error.not-ready: All riders must be connected and ready before the race can start.
strings.multiplayer.error.invalid-name: Names must contain 1 to 24 characters and no control characters.
strings.multiplayer.error.room-settings: Check the room name and number of bots.
strings.multiplayer.error.course-unavailable: This route is still in development. Choose Canyon Run.
strings.multiplayer.error.campaign-locked: This level is locked for your profile. Choose an unlocked level in your career.
strings.multiplayer.error.repair-required: Your bike is wrecked. Leave the room and repair it in the garage before racing.
strings.multiplayer.error.profile-busy: Your profile has a race that has not finished saving. Wait for the results, then try again.
strings.multiplayer.error.profile-revoked: Your profile session has expired or been revoked. Open your account to sign in again.
strings.multiplayer.error.already-in-room: You are already in a room. Leave that room first.
strings.multiplayer.error.profile-in-room: This profile is holding a place in another session. Choose New Guest to add a separate player.
strings.multiplayer.error.profile-unavailable: The server could not read your profile yet. Try again later or choose New Guest.
strings.multiplayer.error.resume-expired: Your reserved place has expired. Reconnect and join a new room.
strings.multiplayer.error.resume-owner: This session has been opened elsewhere. Choose New Guest to play separately.
strings.multiplayer.error.version-mismatch: The game and server versions differ. Reload the page or update your LAN package.
strings.multiplayer.error.server-full: The server is full. Please try again later.
strings.multiplayer.error.room-capacity: The server has reached its room limit. Join a room with space available.
strings.multiplayer.error.persistence-pending: The server is preparing. Please wait a moment.
strings.multiplayer.error.persistence-queue-full: The server is busy saving data. Please try again later.
strings.multiplayer.error.result-save-retry: The server is retrying the result save. Keep this session open to receive confirmation.
strings.multiplayer.error.start-cancelled: The countdown was cancelled because the members or host changed.
strings.multiplayer.error.result-required: The race has not ended yet. Please wait for the official results.
strings.multiplayer.error.command-rate: You are acting too quickly. Wait a moment, then try again.
strings.multiplayer.error.not-room-member: You are no longer in this room. Refresh the list and join again.
strings.multiplayer.error.unknown: This request could not be completed. Try again or reconnect to the server.
strings.multiplayer.heading.eyebrow: RACING BOIS / HIT THE ROAD TOGETHER
strings.multiplayer.browser.empty-rooms: No rooms yet. Create one and send the code to your friends.
strings.multiplayer.invite.link-hint: Select and copy this link to invite friends.
